description: Shared habit vectors for the TypeScript and Kotlin suites (docs/roadmap-v2.md, phase 1). score = 100 * sum(w*credit) / sum(w*(done ? 1 : 2)) over done and missed occurrences in the habit's window up to 'now' (inclusive at both ends), w = 0.5^(daysAgo/(window/2)), window = min(180, max(28, 5 * nominal period)) days, credit = max(0.5, 1 - 0.1*snoozes); fewer than 5 scored occurrences is unranked (score null). Pending (not yet due, or at most grace_minutes late) and excused (cheat day on a passable event) occurrences are left out of the score. Streaks count consecutive done occurrences, skip pending ones, let an excused occurrence keep the run alive without adding to it, and reset on a miss; they use the habit's own window. Outcome lists are oldest first. Scores were evaluated by a script that implements only the formula (not the app code) and are compared with a tolerance of 1e-6. The overall score is 100 * sum(earned) / sum(possible) over the ranked habits, each habit on its own weights. 'windows' pins the window length, 'tiers' pins the boundaries, 'weights' and 'credits' pin the building blocks.

vectors.name: six days all done is Diamond with a 6 streak
an occurrence exactly grace_minutes late is still pending and does not break the streak
one second past grace the occurrence is missed and ends the streak
four scored occurrences are Unranked, with no score
a weekly habit is scored over 35 days and ranked: snooze credit has a 0.5 floor, an occurrence exactly 35 days back counts, older ones do not
a monthly habit is scored over 150 days with a 75 day half-life, so five months make it rankable
overall pools ranked habits with 100 * sum(earned) / sum(possible), each on its own window
Paris spring DST: 08:00 local moves from 07:00Z to 06:00Z, a cheat day excuses without adding to the streak, mixed timestamp formats match, a completion at the old offset does not
a cheat day does not excuse a non-passable event
the cheat day is matched by local date: 00:30 in Tokyo is the previous day in UTC
overall score pools the ranked habits and ignores unranked, one-off and inactive events
no completions at all scores 0, Bronze
scoring starts at created_at: earlier occurrences are neither done nor missed, and one exactly at created_at counts
an occurrence due earlier on the day the alarm was created is not scored, and with too few scored left the habit is Unranked

prayer.description: Prayer scoring (roadmap: honest prayers). Window ends are the prayer's window (Fajr to sunrise, Dhuhr to Asr, Asr to Maghrib, Maghrib to Isha, Isha to the Islamic midnight); the instants come from the app's prayer times for Ariana, which the prayer-times vectors check against Aladhan. A prayer done within 15 minutes of its time is on time (credit 1), inside its window late (0.8, window end plus 2 minutes of slack), after it a qada (0.5); an unmade prayer whose window closed is missed (credit 0, weighs 2 in the denominator). Recency weights are 0.5^(daysAgo/14) from each prayer's own instant. The prayer-day streak: a day with a missed prayer resets it, a day with a qada (and no miss) keeps it without adding, any other settled day adds 1. The expected numbers were computed by a script that implements only this formula over the instants listed here (not the app code).
